title: Extending the Rate-1 Encryptment Impossibility Result
summary: Known rate-1 impossibility results cover fixed-key blockcipher-based encryptment; whether the exclusion extends to no-fixed-order verification algorithms remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether the existing impossibility result extends to all rate-1 no-fixed-order verification algorithms for encryptment.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography focused on authenticated-encryption modes and encryptment verification algorithms.
parameters: no-fixed-order: the verification algorithm's ordering model
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the existing impossibility result extends to all rate-1 no-fixed-order verification algorithms for encryptment.

citations.label: Fast Message Franking: From Invisible Salamanders to Encryptment

progress.summary: The source presents the extension conditionally: a negative result based on [11, Th. 5] would rule out encryptment using any rate-1 no-fixed-order verification algorithm. It does not claim that negative result, so the extension remains unresolved.
citation_labels: Yevgeniy Dodis et al., Fast Message Franking: From Invisible Salamanders to Encryptment
